jobs.title: Clinical Success & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT EVVY

At Evvy, we believe the female body shouldn’t be a medical mystery.

We are a precision women’s health company leveraging the vaginal microbiome to improve outcomes across a woman's lifespan. Backed by $60M+ from leading investors, we serve over 100,000 patients and 3,000 providers nationwide with our validated Vaginal Microbiome Test and AI-powered personalized care platform.

Through this work, we have built the world’s largest dataset on the vaginal microbiome — a proprietary foundation that will drive breakthroughs in infertility, preterm birth, gynecological cancers, and beyond.

Why join now?

Evvy is a generational opportunity in women's health — and we're at the inflection point.



 - We’ve built a dataset no one has. Evvy has generated the world’s largest vaginal microbiome dataset from 100,000+ patients, uncovering novel biological markers underlying women’s health conditions that collectively cost the healthcare system $180B+ annually.

 - Validated, AI-first platform. We’ve built a comprehensive testing and care platform that unlocks personalized treatment pathways for each patient. Our work is supported by research published in major peer-reviewed journals and presented at major clinical conferences (including ACOG, ASRM, IDSOG, and more).

 - Proven traction, massive opportunity. We serve 100,000+ patients and 2,000 providers nationwide, with rapidly growing revenue and an expanding suite of diagnostics and treatments to improve outcomes across condition areas. We've only scratched the surface.

 - Top tier team, investors, and partners. Our world-class team is backed by industry leading investors, including General Catalyst, Left Lane Capital, US Fertility, and Labcorp.



We're looking for high-horsepower, mission-driven people who find it unacceptable that the female body is still a medical mystery — and want to help change that.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

We’re looking for a Clinical Success & Operations Manager to help build the partner experience layer of Evvy’s commercial organization.



You’ll own the ongoing experience for Evvy’s clinic and practitioner partners after they sign — serving as their primary strategic point of contact, internal advocate, and trusted operational partner. Your job is not just to solve problems, but to proactively improve how clinics experience Evvy over time.



This role sits at the intersection of relationship management, operations, and commercial strategy. You’ll work closely across Commercial, Ops, Marketing, Clinical, and Product to ensure our partners feel supported, informed, and set up for long-term success.



As an early member of a growing commercial team, you’ll also help design the systems, workflows, and partner infrastructure that allow Evvy to scale. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity.



Evvy is a primarily in-person team based in New York, NY. Given the cross-functional nature of this role, our ideal candidate is located in NYC.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the Partner Experience

 - Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for Evvy’s clinic and practitioner partners

 - Build strong, trusted relationships across clinic teams and become a reliable strategic partner over time

 - Ensure every new partner has a seamless onboarding experience, from account setup through first order and ongoing adoption

 - Proactively identify friction points, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve the partner experience

 - Partner closely with Operations to resolve complex or high-priority partner issues with speed and care

Build & Scale Operational Infrastructure

 - Help design and improve internal workflows for onboarding, account management, issue resolution, and partner communications

 - Coordinate customized partner-facing assets including educational materials, onboarding resources, one-pagers, decks, and clinic collateral

 - Maintain strong internal communication loops so partner feedback reaches the right teams quickly

 - Support the commercial team in building scalable systems and processes as Evvy grows



Represent Evvy Externally

 - Coordinate and manage Evvy’s presence at clinical conferences, industry events, and partner meetings

 - Build relationships with clinic staff, providers, and prospective partners in person

 - Help reinforce Evvy’s brand as a thoughtful, high-touch partner within women’s health and fertility




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You are:

 - A relationship builder at heart. You genuinely enjoy being the person that partners rely on, and you take pride in making their experience with Evvy exceptional.

 - Operationally sharp. You notice when something is broken, you fix it, and then you figure out how to make sure it doesn't break again. You don't let things fall through the cracks.

 - A strong communicator across audiences who is equally comfortable talking to a clinic coordinator and briefing the Evvy Marketing team on what a partner needs.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and variety. This is an early-stage role on a small team, which means your work will evolve and expand as we grow. You see that as a feature, not a bug.

 - Someone who wants to build something. You're not looking for a static job description, but a chance to help shape how Evvy's commercial team operates as it scales.



You have:

 - 3–5 years of experience in customer success, partnerships, or operations in an early-stage startup

 - Experience managing multiple relationships and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

 - Experience working cross-functionally across teams including Operations, Marketing, Clinical, and Commercial

 - Exceptional organizational and project management skills

 - Comfort working within CRM systems and operational tooling

 - Willingness to travel for clinics, conferences, and partner events as needed



Helpful but not required:

 - Experience in women’s health, diagnostics, or digital health

 - Familiarity with fertility clinic workflows or clinical operations

 - Experience helping build operational systems or partner success processes from scratch




WORKING AT EVVY

Evvy is a primarily in-person team based in New York, NY with a strong culture of collaboration and connection. We work from the office 4 days a week (Wednesdays remote), and we genuinely enjoy spending time together: team dinners, happy hours, and shared wins are part of the rhythm here.




OUR VALUES

Start with the why. We tie everything back to a user need or company goal.
Figure it out. We take initiative, embrace ambiguity, and build from first principles.
Create win-wins. We solve problems with patients, partners, and the business in mind.
Own it to the end. We close every loop and take pride in the details.
Stay eleven steps ahead. We anticipate, plan, and act with foresight and speed.

 
 


COMPANY BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Flexible PTO

 - $1K learning and development budget

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance, plus HSA plans

 - 401(k) plan (Roth and traditional)

 - Monthly team events

 - Free Evvy membership

 - Paid parental leave
   

Evvy is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or other protected characteristics.

All communications will come from an @evvy.com http://evvy.com email address.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a BizOps Sr. Manager to be one of the founding members of Evvy’s BizOps team. This team is critical as we grow into our next phase, surfacing and solving cross-functional problems, translating strategy into execution, eliminating friction, and accelerating Evvy’s progress against our goals.



This role sits at the center of how Evvy operates and grows. You'll operate as a GM across major strategic initiatives — owning strategy through execution — then develop the strategic point of view on the next set of big bets. In parallel, you'll help build the Evvy operating system that allows the company and Evvy’s CEO to execute as effectively as possible against our most ambitious goals.



This role is intentionally broad and dynamic. As a generalist operator, you’ll work on the highest priority company needs and initiatives, which will evolve as the business grows. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re someone who quickly gets up the learning curve, brings structure and execution to ambiguous situations, and knows how to prioritize exceptionally well along the way. Success in this role will vary depending on the work at hand, but you'll always be able to point to a piece of the business you own end-to-end and clearly move forward.



You'll report to Evvy's Chief of Staff & Head of BizOps, and partner closely with our co-founders (primarily our CEO) and functional team leads.



Evvy is an in-person team based in New York, NY. Given the cross-functional nature of this role, our ideal candidate is located in NYC.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


DRIVE NEW BUSINESS BETS

 - Act as a GM for a major strategic initiative against a core company metric, whether it’s a new product, channel, market, or vertical

 - Set the strategy, build the plan, and bring together the right cross-functional teams needed to take it from thesis to launch and beyond

 - As needed, make recommendations on vendors, budget allocation, and hires to leadership team, in order to enable success of the new bet

 - Establish what success looks like upfront, and make the judgment call when the effort is ready to transition to an existing functional owner or spin up a new team


OWN STRATEGY SPRINTS

 - Lead the analysis against  Evvy’s highest-level strategic questions that haven’t yet landed on the company roadmap – think pathway to reimbursement strategy, new product expansion (market sizing, competitive analysis, fit for Evvy), international growth & more

 - Develop a perspective and recommendation to support leadership decisions on what Evvy commits to next, and how it should be sequenced against everything else in flight

 - Partner with functional leaders to translate decisions from these sprints into the right set of next steps


ENGINEER THE EVVY OPERATING SYSTEM

 - Support the company-wide systems and processes that translate strategy into alignment and execution — including quarterly/annual planning cycles, KPIs and business reviews, All Hands, and more

 - Ensure company priorities are translated into clear team-level owners with appropriate resourcing and defined, measurable outcomes

 - Spot organizational friction or decentralized problems as Evvy scales and fix them before it becomes a bigger problem


FORCE MULTIPLY THE CEO

 - Work closely with Evvy’s CEO and Chief of Staff on the recurring and high priority work, including investor relations, advisory board engagement, board presentations, and external touchpoints

 - Provide flexible support in high priority areas where the CEO needs additional leverage




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


YOU HAVE:

 - 5-8 years of experience, with a mix of strategy work (e.g. consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, venture capital, strategic finance) and operating experience at a fast-growing start-up

 - A proven track record leading cross-functional, ambiguous initiatives where you’ve had real ownership and driven meaningful outcomes

 - Strong analytical skills that you’re comfortable adapting to new use cases, whether it’s building a forecast, sizing a market size, or quantifying a launch plan

 - A real knack for moving between big-picture strategy and the operational detail needed to actually build something




YOU ARE:

 - Someone who thrives in situations with high ownership and high ambiguity, and know how to apply thoughtful judgment, bias towards action, and adapt as you get more information

 - Equally excited by building the plan and doing the work to make it real

 - An exceptional, clear communicator (written and verbally) who can bring leadership and cross-functional teams along at the right altitude

 - Adept at building trust and credibility at all levels and with varying functions, without relying on title or top-down authority

 - Energized by context switching and getting to own and touch a wide swath of the business




HELPFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED:

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a VP of Finance to own Finance and People at Evvy as we scale into our next phase of growth. This is a broad, senior operating role: you'll be responsible for both the strategic and technical sides of finance — FP&A, capital strategy, and investor relations alongside accounting — while also overseeing our People function.



You'll lead a high-performing, lean team; stand up the systems and processes Evvy needs to operate at scale (ERP, inventory management, revenue automation;, and serve as a close partner to Evvy's CEO and board on everything from fundraising to budgeting to compensation.



You'll report directly to Evvy's CEO and sit on the leadership team. Evvy is an in-person team based in New York, NY. This role is based in our NYC office.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN STRATEGIC FINANCE

 - Lead revenue forecasting and company-wide budgeting, including hiring plans and resource allocation

 - Build and maintain pricing and business-case models for new products, provider relationships, and partnerships

 - Own capital strategy planning and investor financial reporting, and serve as a key point of contact for existing and prospective investors
   
    


LEAD ACCOUNTING & CONTROLLERSHIP

 - Oversee the Controller and the accounting function, including month-end close, GAAP compliance, and tax, getting Evvy to audit-ready status

 - Lead implementation and adoption of an ERP and inventory management system as Evvy scales its offerings




BUILD EVVY'S FINANCIAL & OPERATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Own the systems roadmap for finance and operations

 - Oversee bill pay, cash management, sales tax, insurance renewals, and vendor relationships (banking, tax, insurance)

 - Bring in-house capabilities (e.g., HRIS/payroll) at the right inflection points as Evvy crosses key headcount and complexity thresholds




OWN THE PEOPLE FUNCTION

 - Oversee the People Ops Manager and Evvy's People operations — recruiting infrastructure, onboarding, HR inquiries, benefits, and compliance, office management, and the operational backbone (space, vendors, offsites) that keeps an in-person team running well

 - Partner with the CEO on performance management, leveling, and calibration processes as Evvy scales its team




FORCE MULTIPLY THE CEO & LEADERSHIP TEAM

 - Partner closely with Evvy's CEO on board meeting preparation, investor relations, and recurring high-priority finance and people workstreams

 - Represent finance and people in company-wide planning cycles, KPI reviews, and All Hands

 - Provide judgment and leverage in ambiguous, cross-functional situations that touch finance, people, or operations

 
 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


YOU HAVE:

 - Head-of or VP-level experience leading a Finance function at a startup, ideally with direct oversight of both strategic finance/FP&A and accounting

 - A mix of formal finance training (investment banking, corporate finance, or similar) and hands-on operating experience at a fast-growing startup

 - A track record of building financial infrastructure and processes from the ground up — systems implementations, audit-readiness, or scaling a finance team

 - Experience managing investor relationships

 - Comfort owning People/HR alongside finance, even without a formal HR background

 


YOU ARE:

 - A builder who's equally comfortable setting strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute

 - A clear, credible communicator who can operate at the board level and in the operational details

 - Someone who thrives with high ownership and high ambiguity, and brings structure to undefined problems

 - Energized by owning a wide swath of the business — finance, accounting, and people — rather than a single narrow lane

 


HELPFUL BUT NOT REQUIRED:

 - Experience with payor coverage, reimbursement, or revenue cycle management (RCM)

You'll own capital allocation across all of it, with AI embedded throughout, not bolted on.



Reporting directly to the Co-founder & CMO, you'll set the strategy, hold the P&L, and be accountable for outcomes.



Evvy is a primarily in-person team based in NYC. Given the cross-functional nature of this role, our ideal candidate is located in NYC.

 - Define how content, influencer, and community-driven growth feed the funnel — and build the incrementality and attribution infrastructure to know when they're working

 - Oversee CRO, landing page strategy, email capture, and referral programs as compounding growth levers, not afterthoughts

 - Build the retention and lifecycle programs that turn first-time customers into long-term subscribers — at Evvy, the relationship doesn't end at purchase

 - Create the experimentation cadence that lets the team move fast and make good decisions, with AI embedded throughout

 - Directly manage senior reports and build a growth org that performs with the urgency this mission deserves

 - Identify new growth surfaces before the business needs them and build the case to go after them

 - 10+ years in growth or digital marketing, with at least 7 years focused on acquisition and 3+ years managing reports and owning commercial outcomes

 - You've built the engine, not just run it — you can point to growth infrastructure you stood up and the results it produced

 - Genuine fluency in measurement: you understand the difference between correlation and causation in marketing data, and you build systems accordingly

 - Strong point of view on AI and how it applies to growth workflows — from creative testing to experimentation infrastructure to reporting — and a track record of actually using it
